title: Vision Extraction Output Schema
description: Schema for a single vision-model extraction result. The caller or source registry supplies the authoritative source_id; the model's self-reported source_id is only advisory and is overwritten by the pipeline.

source_id.description: Authoritative source_id. Supplied by the caller or source registry, NOT by the model. If the model's self-reported source_id disagrees, the mismatch is recorded in source_id_advisory.

source_id_advisory.description: The source_id the model self-reports, before the authoritative override. Null when the model output did not self-report a source_id. Used only for audit, never for identity.

source_id_mismatch.description: True when the authoritative source_id differs from the advisory source_id.

content.description: The structured extraction payload. Schema of this object is pipeline-specific and versioned independently.
